fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on the Charles Haynes manslaughter verdict in the killing of Policeman Frank Beckham, with discussion of prohibition and jury decision-making; a major editorial criticizing Florida Power & Light Company and related power-trust influence (including National Electric Light Association and Electric Share & Bond Company) and utility rates; a letter explaining postponement of a recall effort targeting city commissioners Sewell, Platt and Knight; coverage of convention-related business impacts (Shrine convention and upcoming Elks convention), local political campaign advertising and notes, and an editorial urging financial support and governance improvements for the University of Miami. Includes local news bulletins and columns on Miami, Miami Beach, and regional topics including Nassau/Bahamas and the Everglades.
